title: Meal Planning on a Changing Schedule · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少80词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short paragraph (about 50 words) about your meal plan for next week. Use much, many, a little, a few, should, and should not. Explain what you will buy and what you should not buy.
Write at least 80 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
